summary: This clinical trial studies how a treatment called fecal microbiota transplantation affects gut bacteria and blood sugar control in people with type 2 diabetes. Fecal microbiota transplantation involves transferring stool from a healthy donor into the digestive tract of a patient. A placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the treatment, is used for comparison. Central Jutland Regional Hospital sponsored this completed study with 16 participants.
